Equipment
 Air injection compressors (60 bar) 
 High air compressors (60 bar )
 Low air compressors
 Italy

This document outlines the equipment 
 inspection I1, which must be performed annually bases as indicated by Y1 
 in the title block

Esna power plant contain three groups of different 
 compressors:

Two compressors high air pressure (60 bar) to feed the high 
 air pressure to go mechanical governor speed and reduced to 32 bar to feed 
 breaking units to stop

Two compressors high air injection compressor (60bar) to 
 produce compressed air for turbines at 
 (Emergency shut down load rejection slice mode)

Two compressors low air pressure system (7 bar) to feed (seal 
 water , water in take screen blowing service, water pressurization vessels various 
 available fast connection at elevation 78,73.5,70,56.5)

items:
A work permit must be issued, 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety ID category

Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety and healthy 
 protective equipment as safety shoes, helmet .... etc

Main supply disconnected switch 
 in open position

Maintenance is carried out with 
 cooperation with electrical department

Mechanical tools 
 ( complete set of manual wrench - brushes - etc)

Tighten hexagonal screw with a 
 torque 
 wrench

Manually drain condensate traps if the unit is being operated during periods of 
 high
Check oil level in sump and refill as required
Drain oil sump and renew oil and replace oil filters
Inspect clean and refill with oil
Clean and inspect for damaged fins
Check cooling cycles for all stages of compressors
